milestone.title: RFC 0002 M2: Complete pool and baseline

body:
Parent: #7

Milestone: M2. Registered stage authorized under operations #59; dispatch still requires completed dependencies and agent-ready. Refine into bounded child tasks before implementation when needed.

Dependencies: #80.

## Acceptance and scope

- [ ] Implement off/counters/sampled_trace/full_replay modes, worker-local aggregation, all §6 metrics, bounded cardinality, privacy, bounded buffers and explicit diagnostic drops/incomplete replay.
- [ ] Freeze workload/policies/versions; profile transition/legal-action/encoding/allocation/effect/cache/synchronization costs, memory and outcome accounting. Verify semantic equality across modes.
- [ ] Publish baseline scalar performance/memory and dominant costs; no unmeasured speed claims or workload weakening.

## Authoritative requirements

The exact RFC text remains authoritative. These block references preserve all assigned clauses, tables and examples; shared blocks have multiple stage owners and are not fully satisfied by one task. Implement the aspects applicable to this task and retain later obligations.

- `R0002-B008` — [Separate the performance objectives](https://github.com/pabloxrl/mtg-lab/blob/9534e4bcf2dc511aa5cc26f2b5e3b36e4182932a/doc/rfcs/0002-first-mvp.md#L69-L84)
- `R0002-B014` — [Why Rust for the core, rather than Python?](https://github.com/pabloxrl/mtg-lab/blob/9534e4bcf2dc511aa5cc26f2b5e3b36e4182932a/doc/rfcs/0002-first-mvp.md#L165-L183)
- `R0002-B019` — [Provisional targets, not acceptance claims](https://github.com/pabloxrl/mtg-lab/blob/9534e4bcf2dc511aa5cc26f2b5e3b36e4182932a/doc/rfcs/0002-first-mvp.md#L223-L239)
- `R0002-B020` — [Required benchmark tracks](https://github.com/pabloxrl/mtg-lab/blob/9534e4bcf2dc511aa5cc26f2b5e3b36e4182932a/doc/rfcs/0002-first-mvp.md#L240-L254)
- `R0002-B021` — [6. Instrumentation without making the hot path expensive](https://github.com/pabloxrl/mtg-lab/blob/9534e4bcf2dc511aa5cc26f2b5e3b36e4182932a/doc/rfcs/0002-first-mvp.md#L255-L277)

## Delivery contract

Follow AGENTS.md and WORKFLOW.md, source pins and program manifest. Establish behavioral red/green evidence where behavior changes, use independent expectations and relevant references, run verify.sh and task-specific checks, commit a clean candidate, obtain a separate agent review, merge through required CI, verify exact main SHA, and record the workpad before atomic closure. Never weaken gates or silently omit requirements. No human plan or PR approval. Update the parent evidence and perform the bounded program handoff before closing. Missing reference engines/access is a blocker, never a pass.


## Reviewed test delivery plan (operations #54)
Implement the applicable cases in the [test strategy](https://github.com/pabloxrl/mtg-lab/blob/537a18c3ebfde6787a0683d8a6cff406e2a9d19d/doc/testing/README.md), [capability/category catalog](https://github.com/pabloxrl/mtg-lab/blob/537a18c3ebfde6787a0683d8a6cff406e2a9d19d/doc/testing/capability-test-plan.json), [game replay plan](https://github.com/pabloxrl/mtg-lab/blob/537a18c3ebfde6787a0683d8a6cff406e2a9d19d/doc/testing/game-replay.md), [system tests](https://github.com/pabloxrl/mtg-lab/blob/537a18c3ebfde6787a0683d8a6cff406e2a9d19d/doc/testing/systems.md), [independent data/RL tests](https://github.com/pabloxrl/mtg-lab/blob/537a18c3ebfde6787a0683d8a6cff406e2a9d19d/doc/testing/data-rl.md), and [contract defaults](https://github.com/pabloxrl/mtg-lab/blob/537a18c3ebfde6787a0683d8a6cff406e2a9d19d/doc/testing/contract-decisions.md). Stable case IDs identify the owning issues and implementation stage. This supplements every acceptance requirement above; none is removed. The original designs are not executed evidence. Preserve behavioral red/green, admitted provenance, independent expected outcomes, and exact-version receipts. All development/reference execution stays in Docker; later milestone authorization still follows the manifest.


## Gated progression (operations #59)
The reviewed manifest at `537a18c3ebfde6787a0683d8a6cff406e2a9d19d` authorizes the existing M1–M5 tasks under the standing full-program mandate. This does not satisfy dependencies or mark implementation complete. Follow current-main WORKFLOW.md: after reviewed delivery and exact-main CI, queue at most one eligible registered successor before closure, including across successful milestone gates. No separate routine stage activation is needed. Preserve pause/hold/removed-label controls; never bypass a failed dependency or add scope. Check README impact on delivery.


## Atomic planning prerequisite — operations #61
Coordinator planning #80 must finish the reviewed atomic split before this component is dispatched. Preserve this full acceptance as integration obligations; do not treat this backlog brief as one giant implementation PR. Current-main ownership/graph supersedes historical plan links.


## M2 atomic amendment proposed by #80

After #80 reviewed merge and exact-main CI, this issue is a bounded full-acceptance integration/evidence audit. Its original acceptance and RFC ownership above remain mandatory, not waived or replaced. Its child deliveries implement the scoped pieces; enumerate every original clause and exact executable/reference receipt, fix only bounded integration defects, and report a concrete coordinator split for broad missing implementation. Direct prerequisites under the amendment: #217.

[Complete deliverable/test/ownership crosswalk](https://github.com/pabloxrl/mtg-lab/blob/main/doc/programs/m2-atomic-delivery.md) and [all 175 unchanged M2 catalog cases](https://github.com/pabloxrl/mtg-lab/blob/main/doc/programs/m2-test-crosswalk.md). Current-main manifest remains authoritative until merged; native component dependencies will be reconciled after verified merge. No readiness is granted by this annotation.

## Registration delivered

#80's [protected PR #218](https://github.com/pabloxrl/mtg-lab/pull/218) merged as `bfc422b347a8743245fc99f86b691ade7d7dffe3`; [exact-main CI passed](https://github.com/pabloxrl/mtg-lab/actions/runs/36981137452). The current-main manifest and linked M2 plan now govern the dependencies and bounded scope, superseding the proposal-era dependency summary above. Native links have been reconciled. Registration does not complete this issue or grant readiness; normal dependency/control checks and explicit handoff still apply. Every original acceptance requirement remains.
